# /crav1-design-ui

lane: specify | group: Specify | starter: no | stage: stable | since: 1.211.0 | prompts: 3
purpose: Design a slice's user-facing screens after the spec is accepted and before the plan, with one sign-off item per screen.
use_when: An accepted spec has a user-facing UI to design before the plan
prompt_note: One card when a UI is unclear, one batch for the visual (and the signer when the spec names none), one closing yes.
reads: Reads `spec.md`, the slice's `ui/` files and their Approval needed items, UI patterns in `docs/system/`, and the existing screens in code when `## In the code` names paths. Looks at a screenshot only to understand feedback.
writes: After one closing yes: `ui/design.md`, `ui/experience.md`, the mock under `ui/mock/` when chosen, and through `ui_screens.py sync --yes` one Approval needed item per new screen, a refreshed `Screen:` mark, or a `Cleared:` mark. On the skip path one `UI: none (<reason>)` line.
leaves alone: Leaves requirements, `plan.md`, `tasks.md`, `verify.md`, `docs/system/`, code, and `Approved:` lines alone. Writes no binary file. Does not commit.
limits: Refuses application code. A new requirement goes to `/crav1-add-to-spec`. Not a starter option. Runs before `/crav1-design-architecture` when both apply.
flow:
- Skips a slice that clearly has no UI; when unclear it asks once (design, or `UI: none (<reason>)`).
- `ui/design.md` holds the look, layout per screen and the tokens (one `yaml` block: colours, typography, spacing, radius).
- `ui/experience.md` holds each `### <name> (S<n>)` with at least the empty, loading, error and full-of-data states, its interactions, and yes/no checks `(S1-C1)`.
- One visual, always: an HTML mock under `ui/mock/` (zoom, docking, motion, a clickable flow; never shipped, not a plan input), PlantUML Salt (static layout), or Mermaid (flows and states); text art only when none renders.
- `scripts/ui_screens.py sync --yes` adds one Approval needed item per screen through `approval_needed.py` `add_item`, with a `Screen:` mark.
- A material change to a signed-off screen appends `Cleared:`; a typo keeps the yes, and the script says why.
- It never writes `Approved:` and never stores a screenshot.

## Choice words
- question: The HTML mock (optional; a word in the invocation takes that choice without asking)
  - `with-mock`: also write the throwaway HTML mock under `ui/mock/` (never shipped, not a plan input)
  - `skip-mock`: no HTML mock this run; the visual is PlantUML Salt, Mermaid, or text art inside the Markdown
  note: With no word, the visual card asks. When the spec names a screen and has no ui/ files and no UI: none line, one card asks first: design (Recommended) or no-ui. A run with no person in the chat writes nothing and names with-mock and skip-mock.
called_by: Called by the user. `/crav1-tighten-and-plan-ready-to-build` opens it on its own before the plan when the slice has a UI.
runs by itself: Calls no skill. It names `/crav1-record-approval` and `/crav1-plan-from-spec`.
you run next: /crav1-record-approval; /crav1-plan-from-spec; /crav1-finalize-commit
first: `/crav1-design-ui orders-dashboard The orders dashboard screen is in the spec. Design its screens before the plan. Do not write code.`
walkthrough: from-design-ui.md
